ignored_columns.description: A list of columns which may be present in the schema JSON, but that will be ignored when setting columns in Adverity.

schema.description: A JSON schema with all the required columns and their datatype.

block.description: This resource will manage all the colmuns and their datatypes for a given Adverity datastream. Due to the way the API works, any columns created outside of this resource for the datastream will be overridden, including deleting existing columns.

enabled.description: Whether the datastream should be enabled or not.

extract_name_keys.description: The name of the date column for splitting extracts.

is_insights_mediaplan.description: If true, generated extracts will be treated as Insights mediaplans.

manage_extract_names.description: Split by selected date column and name extracts with pre-defined pattern to consolidate data.

overwrite_datastream.description: Delete/Drop all existing rows (created by this datastream) in the destination before inserting a new import.

overwrite_filename.description: Overwrite rows from same extract file.

overwrite_key_columns.description: Overwrite rows according to Key defined in Schema Mapping.

retention_number.description: The amount (N) of fetches/extracts/days to retain (raw extracts are not counted). Must be an integer greater than zero.

retention_type.description: Retention Type options: 1: Retain All, 2: Retain N fetches, 3: Retain N days, 4: Retain N extracts

max_start.description: The latest UTC time at which schedules must start, in the format hh:mm.

min_start.description: The minimum UTC time at which schedules can start, in the format hh:mm.

randomise_start_time.description: If set to true, the start time of the day of the schedules belonging to this datastream will be set randomly on creation or update.

block.description: A configuration to randomise the time of day for when fetches should be scheduled.

cron_preset.description: A string indicating how often the datastream should be scheduled.

time_range_preset.description: A number corresponding to the time range for which the schedule shoudl fetch data.

error_on_missing_columns.description: If set to true, the resource will throw an error if a column in the schema is not found in Adverity or vice versa.

replace_special_characters.description: If set to true, special characters in Adverity will be replaced by underscores, and names beginning with a number will start with an "n" instead.

schema.description: A JSON schema, as extracted from a BigQuery table.

wait_for_columns.description: If set to true, the resource will wait until at least one column exists in the API before proceeding.

block.description: This is an experimental resource meant to be used when exporting data without using the schema mapping feature to BigQuery. It takes as input the desired Schema that the BigQuery table has (the same format as when you would export a schema from a BigQuery table). It will read all columns associated with the specified datastream and make sure they are all the same datatype as specified in the schema. It has quite a few nested loops, so even though effort has been made to optimise it, large schemas may cause this resource to take some time. Patch requests to change columns will only be done if they are different from the desired datatype or if they are not fixed yet.

destination_type.description: The type ID of the destination.

headers_formatting.description: A number corresponding to a style of header formatting.

schema_mapping.description: If set to false, schema mapping will be turned off for this destination.

stack.description: The Id of the workspace this destination belongs to.

block.description: This resource will create a destination. Currently only supports BigQuery destinations.

destination_type.description: The type ID of the destination.

table_name.description: The name of the table in this destination the datstream should write to. This will create a table if none exists.

block.description: This resource maps a datasytream to a destination, amking sure that the data from the datastream fetches ends up in the given destination.

datastream_id.description: The ID of the datastream this fetch belongs to.

days_to_fetch.description: The amount of days to go back for the fetch.

disable.description: If set to true, the resource will be created, but the fetch will wait until this value is set to false before running. Useful if the configuration for the fetch is created before the connection for the datastream is authorised.

end_date.description: The end date in this format -> 2006-01-02. (YYYY - MM - DD)

is_waiting.description: Variable to check if the fetch job is disabled and is waiting to be enabled.

job_id.description: The ID in Adverity for this fetching job.

mode.description: The mode of the fetching jobs specifies what time windows should be used. 'Days' will fetch all data from the amount of days specified until now. The 'current' options will fetch from the beginning of the current month/week. The 'previous' options will put the start date at the beginning of the week/month a specified number of days ago, and the enddate at the end of the previous week/month. 'Custom' will make a custom fetch based on the start and end date specified in the arguments.

start_date.description: The start date in this format -> 2006-01-02. (YYYY - MM - DD)

status.description: The status of the job at the time this resource was last read.

wait_until_completion.description: If set to true, Terraform will wait until the fetch has completed before reporting this resource as created.

block.description: Create a single data fetching job in Adverity for a particular datastream.
